description: Literature census of all 15 reported biallelic MSH3 patients plus a Hardy-Weinberg prevalence model
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint

rows = [
 ("Adam-F1","A-II.1","M",55,"~50","CRC","duodenal adenomas","gastric cancer",27476653),
 ("Adam-F1","A-II.2","F",45,"~20",None,"duodenal adenomas","astrocytoma (early onset)",27476653),
 ("Adam-F2","B-II.1","M",47,"~60","CRC",None,None,27476653),
 ("Adam-F2","B-II.2","M",40,"~30",None,None,None,27476653),
 ("Aelvoet","index","M",55,52,"rectal cancer","none","liver cysts",35675019),
 ("Aelvoet","sib1","F",46,54,None,"none","breast ca (ectopic tissue), liver cysts",35675019),
 ("Aelvoet","sib2","M",59,18,None,"none","liver cysts",35675019),
 ("Aelvoet","sib3","M",50,30,None,"none",None,35675019),
 ("Villy","P1","F",50,np.nan,None,"duodenal polyposis","breast carcinoma",37402566),
 ("Villy","P2","F",52,np.nan,None,"duodenal polyposis","breast carcinoma",37402566),
 ("Villy","P3","M",48,np.nan,None,None,None,37402566),
 ("Villy","P4","M",55,np.nan,None,None,None,37402566),
 ("Villy","P5","M",45,np.nan,None,None,None,37402566),
 ("Koi","P1","M",43,np.nan,"CRC (43y)",None,None,38243056),
 ("Gavric","P1","F",49,19,None,None,"2 BCC, liver+kidney cysts",37597744),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["family","patient","sex","age_dx","adenomas","crc","duodenal","extracolonic","pmid"])
print("Published biallelic MSH3 patients:", len(df), "from", df.family.nunique(), "families")
print("Sex M:F =", (df.sex=="M").sum(), ":", (df.sex=="F").sum())
a = df.age_dx.astype(float)
print("Age at polyposis dx: median %.0f, range %d-%d, mean %.1f (SD %.1f)" % (a.median(),a.min(),a.max(),a.mean(),a.std()))
for lab,col,test in [("CRC","crc",lambda s: s.notna()),
                     ("Duodenal polyps","duodenal",lambda s: s.notna()&(s!="none"))]:
    k = int(test(df[col]).sum()); lo,hi = proportion_confint(k,len(df),method="wilson")
    print(f"{lab}: {k}/{len(df)} = {100*k/len(df):.0f}% (95% CI {100*lo:.0f}-{100*hi:.0f}%)")
cnt = pd.to_numeric(df.adenomas, errors="coerce").dropna()
print("Countable adenoma burden n=%d: median %.0f, range %d-%d; all <100 = %s" %
      (len(cnt),cnt.median(),cnt.min(),cnt.max(),bool((cnt<100).all())))

# Carrier-frequency / prevalence model for an autosomal recessive condition
# MSH3 LoF allele frequency in gnomAD-scale populations (published estimate ~1-2 per 1000)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
q = np.logspace(-4, -2.3, 200)            # biallelic-competent LoF allele frequency
prev = (q**2) * 1e6                        # homozygote/compound-het frequency per million
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 4.4))

ax = axes[0]
ax.hist(a, bins=np.arange(38, 64, 4), color="#4C72B0", edgecolor="white")
ax.axvline(a.median(), color="#C44E52", ls="--", lw=2, label=f"median {a.median():.0f} y")
ax.set_xlabel("Age at polyposis diagnosis (years)"); ax.set_ylabel("Patients")
ax.set_title("Onset is adult, fourth to sixth decade\n(n=15 reported biallelic MSH3 carriers)")
ax.legend(frameon=False)

ax = axes[1]
ax.bar(range(len(cnt)), sorted(cnt), color="#55A868")
ax.axhline(100, color="#C44E52", ls="--", lw=2, label="FAP threshold (100 adenomas)")
ax.set_xlabel("Patient (sorted)"); ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative adenomas")
ax.set_ylim(0, 115); ax.set_title("Adenoma burden stays in the\nattenuated range (18 to 60)")
ax.legend(frameon=False)

ax = axes[2]
ax.loglog(q, prev, color="#4C72B0", lw=2)
for qq, lab in [(1e-3, "LoF AF 1/1000"), (3e-4, "LoF AF 3/10 000")]:
    ax.plot(qq, qq**2*1e6, "o", color="#C44E52")
    ax.annotate(f"{lab}\n{qq**2*1e6:.2f} per million", (qq, qq**2*1e6),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(8, -18), fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("MSH3 biallelic-competent LoF allele frequency")
ax.set_ylabel("Expected affected per million")
ax.set_title("Hardy-Weinberg prevalence model\nfor a recessive MSH3 polyposis")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

for qq in [3e-4, 1e-3, 2e-3]:
    print(f"q={qq:.1e} -> carrier freq {2*qq:.4f} (1 in {1/(2*qq):.0f}), affected {qq**2*1e6:.3f}/million")
